steps: Prefer an IAM user with only the permissions your app needs, not the root account
IAM > Users > your user > Security credentials > Create access key
Pick the use case 'Other' and click Next (the console suggests alternatives to long-term keys; use them if they fit)
Copy the Access key ID and the Secret access key - the secret is shown once
Temporary keys (ASIA...) also need a session token, which this recipe does not collect

least_privilege.summary: Give the IAM user only the actions your app needs. This check (GetCallerIdentity) needs no permission at all.
